prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production game background for Underwrite, village_ground v2, 3840x2160 landscape 16:9 opaque. Reference image 1 is v1: preserve its warm delicate drawn outlines, soft clear matte cel-painted medieval materials and palette ONLY; completely redesign viewpoint and density. Image 2 is same project interior style reference.
Full-bleed enclosed CASTLE INNER TOWN, no sky, no horizon, no people, no animals, NO text, no lettering, numbers, symbols resembling signs, or watermark. Daylight from UPPER LEFT, shadows LOWER RIGHT. Calm low-contrast large paving stones, not busy micro-texture.
CRITICAL VIEW: low oblique orthographic 30 degree downward view, front elevations dominant. Every true horizontal circular top (well rim, round tavern table, barrel lid) must be ellipse vertical diameter / horizontal diameter exactly 0.50, permitted 0.45–0.55. Not high overhead 40–60 degrees. EVERY building: vertical FRONT WALL from principal eave to ground at least 2.3 times projected roof depth from ridge to eave. Shallow visible roof strips, tall visible walls. Do not count gables as wall. Use front-facing facades throughout, all six destinations entered from BELOW.
Composition in percentage coordinates, upper left origin: solid tall crenellated castle walls border all four sides, with closed gate at far right edge. Largest tallest lord's manor top centre at x44–60%, y5–30%, flagpoles, dressed stone front steps and tended forecourt. Tavern left upper side x8–24%, y16–43%, ivory plaster and timber, red tiles, warm lit windows, barrels and two small round outdoor tables and stools beside facade. Solid stone adventurer guild right upper side x72–89%, y14–42%, tall windows and sealed parchment beside south door. Blacksmith left lower x7–23%, y58–80%, chimney smoke, anvil, water tub, stacked iron, red glow in doorway. Roofed market noticeboard right lower x71–82%, y62–77%, blank papers and adjoining row of cloth-covered stalls x83–93%, y63–80%. Inconspicuous underground market entrance far LOWER LEFT corner x7–13%, y86–94%, at end of narrow alley behind workshop: southward-facing descending stone stairwell and iron door, accessible alley. Manor is highest destination. Additional attached resident houses in upper-left and upper-right strips and bottom-centre row x33–62%,y82–96%, make 8 small residences grouped close with narrow alleys. Simple shallow roofs, tall front walls. Central communal WELL around x51%, y53%, horizontally elliptical rim ratio 0.50; low well body, no tall canopy. Several lamp posts, cart, logs, laundry, flower beds and a few trees confined beside buildings.
Dense inhabited settlement with open streets, NOT isolated buildings in enormous plaza. Still reserve at least 40% of total image as one connected WALKABLE surface. Clear horizontal street across y46–61% and branching wide streets connect all six entrances below their facades. Main lanes at least 165 pixels wide at 3840 scale, including route into hidden entrance. No stalls, trees, carts or wall block these paths. Human scale: 135px adult height in full 3840x2160 canvas, door height about 170px, small table width about 95px. Buildings suitably scaled relative to this. No character painted in image. Floor continues to bottom border castle wall. Deliver single finished game painting, no panels, annotations or inset.

Edit this town painting. Preserve layout, all buildings and props, warm drawn painting style, palette, upper-left daylight, no people or text. Critical geometric correction: current rooftops are far too tall on screen. Redraw ALL roofs as very shallow strips, shrinking their vertical projected ridge-to-eave depth to ONE THIRD the current depth, while keeping existing eave heights and ground levels. Move ridges DOWN close to eaves, DO NOT shrink facade walls. This applies manor, guild, tavern, blacksmith, ALL small houses including front bottom row, and noticeboard. A rectangular front wall from eave to ground must be visibly at least 2.3 times roof vertical depth. Flat low-pitched medieval roofs, no tall gables; near frontal low 30degree orthographic camera. Roofs are narrow caps above tall walls. Keep all circular horizontal tops ellipses exactly 2 wide to 1 high: tavern tables, barrel lids, well rim, blacksmith water tub. Preserve walkable broad connected streets and six south facing entrances, hidden iron door lower left, no sky. Whole image 3840x2160 landscape 16:9.

Precise-object-edit: keep the entire painting absolutely unchanged EXCEPT MAIN ROOF of top-centre manor and MAIN ROOF of upper-right stone guild. Their roof strips are still too deep. On manor move main long roof ridge DOWN from y~35 to y~80 while keep main eave at y~120. On guild move main long roof ridge DOWN from y~125 to y~175 while keep main eave at y~215 (coordinates in this 1672x941 image). Thus both main roofs only about40px deep, while walls remain 135–150px tall. Lower chimney tops and towers appropriately, keep flagpoles. Gables can be smaller. Do not move doorways, ground, windows, other buildings, well, table, tub, props or streets. No text. No people. Keep the original painted medium and warm upper-left sunlight. Render full image landscape 16:9.
